title: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt: card flavor text

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel whose unmaking left Innistrad's cathars and survivors in despair.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who lifts people from despair and battles Sorin; her priest is Verna.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who freezes the sun and werewolves in place, and seeks the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who races to his grandfather's resting-crypt sensing a plot and battles Sigarda.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who seeks clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts.

entities.name: Arlinn
entities.description: A planeswalker with a loyal werewolf pack who recovers the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who dispatches spirits and describes a covetous geist.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf leader whose howlpack grows bolder and who joins the assault on the cathars.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A cathar of the Order of Saint Traft who takes no joy in violence.

entities.name: Heida
entities.description: A fighter who watches a beast fall and prepares for a long night.

entities.name: Silverstreak
entities.description: A gryff who lost her rider but still helps humankind.

entities.name: Geor
entities.description: A Havengul fisher who fishes for something big and warns about gryffs.

entities.name: Barton
entities.description: A stitcher who comments on switches that sometimes explode.

entities.name: Widow Weber
entities.description: A widow whose scarecrow attracts crows.

entities.name: Verna
entities.description: A priest of Sigarda who worries about ravens.

entities.name: Yzlkpk
entities.description: An observer whose laboratory notes describe a homunculus in a crystal.

entities.name: Uda
entities.description: A hat maker from Selhoff who became a skaab sewer after werewolves destroyed her boutique.

entities.name: Emili
entities.description: A guard captain who warns against investigating cellar groaning.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who commands zombies and brags about a Morkrut Behemoth.

entities.name: Jadar
entities.description: A ghoulcaller of Nephalia who raises the dead to serve.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon worshiped by the Skirsdag cult who corrupts and rewards followers.

entities.name: Jerren
entities.description: A faithful, useful follower addressed by Ormendahl.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon whose defeat did not end the Skirsdag cult.

entities.name: Skirsdag cult
entities.description: A demon-worshiping cult that turned to the next demon after Griselbrand's defeat.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire who says vampires pursue the joy of their first night's feast.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline whose debased remnants prowl the passes near their ruined castles.

entities.name: Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire house ascendant, with torture pits, blood tithes and sky-borne agents.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who ambushes a ritualist and sends an invitation to her wedding.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire line whose members steal from the blood tithes.

entities.name: Markov
entities.description: A vampire bloodline cultivating decadent elegance with a deadly fighting force.

entities.name: Dawnhart
entities.description: Witches focused on nature and community.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The Dawnhart Prime who trusts Ghrin-Danu and reads the land's warnings.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: A deity to whom even steel and stone return, who has not abandoned the faithful.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A Kessig ranger who comments on Plummet.

entities.name: Paulin
entities.description: A trapper of Somberwald who identifies a shadowbeast.

entities.name: Bruno
entities.description: An Ulvenwald guide whose last words mistake a werewolf for a wolf.

entities.name: Captain Eberheart
entities.description: A captain who advises one shot against a charging werewolf.

entities.name: Barnes
entities.description: A village watch member who describes Tovolar's cunning.

entities.name: Ivold
entities.description: An observer who thinks he sees geists through lenses.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The long-lost key to the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock, needed to restore the day-night balance.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: A lock at the center of the Celestus ritual that must be reunited with its key.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: A mechanism that governs the day-night balance, defended by witch, werewolf and cathar.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Innistrad's holy defenders who carry out Avacyn's work and fight werewolves.

entities.name: Parish-Blades
entities.description: Elite cathars who train to delay and frustrate beasts.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane of werewolves, vampires and cathars.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A ruined city patrolled by cathars.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A province with children's rhymes and young seekers of answers.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region that celebrates with fearsome faces and burns effigies.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region with chaotic tides.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region that blazes with new heat.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: A place home to a fisher named Geor.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A town where Uda's hat boutique was destroyed.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: A town whose cobbled streets echo with howls.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: A forest whose wolves adopt inventive hunting techniques.

entities.name: Somberwald
entities.description: A forest where travelers scan for werewolves.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A burning chasm where ancient evils dwell.

entities.name: Erdwal
entities.description: A maze-like set of passages where a wrong turn can be fatal.

entities.name: the Travails
entities.description: A past calamity on Innistrad survived by its people.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrosities whose threat required geist-fueled weapons.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: A festival infiltrated by Tovolar's werewolves.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: The rest of the dead, delayed by a generous soul.

events.summary: Survivors lose faith after Avacyn is gone and a sister is lost.
events.quote: With Avacyn gone, I no longer knew who to pray to.

events.summary: Sigarda lifts a person from despair and gives them strength to fight.
events.quote: It was Sigarda who lifted me from despair and gave me the strength to fight on.

events.summary: Teferi freezes the sun and the werewolves in the middle of a fight.
events.quote: Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.

events.summary: Some cathars succumb to despair at Avacyn's unmaking while others carry on her work.
events.quote: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking.

events.summary: Sorin races to his grandfather's resting-crypt but someone else arrives first.
events.quote: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt.

events.summary: A victim calls out to Sigarda and sees tormentors blaze with sunlight.
events.quote: I called out to Sigarda.

events.summary: Silverstreak loses her rider but keeps helping humankind.
events.quote: Silverstreak had lost her rider, but not her instinct to help humankind.

events.summary: Cathars patrol the ruins of Thraben.
events.quote: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.

events.summary: Heida watches a beast fall and expects a long night.
events.quote: It would be a long, long night.

events.summary: Chandra, Teferi and Arlinn search for the Moonsilver Key while Kaya clears spirits.
events.quote: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.

events.summary: A crowd boasts of surviving the Travails and refuses to fear werewolves.
events.quote: We survived the Travails!

events.summary: Odric dispatches twisted things to save lives.
events.quote: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched.

events.summary: Geor is determined to stay out fishing until something big bites.
events.quote: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

events.summary: Barton comments that his stitched creations usually work.
events.quote: Works every time! Well, every time they don't explode, anyway.

events.summary: Geor advises following a gryff when lost in a storm.
events.quote: If you're lost in a storm, follow a gryff. They always know which way calmer waters lie.

events.summary: Geor sees a gryff that is no longer a gryff.
events.quote: Wait! That's no gryff—at least not anymore.

events.summary: Geist-fueled weapons defended towns against cultists and Eldrazi during the Travails.
events.quote: Necro-alchemists gained popular support during the Travails, when geist-fueled weapons helped defend towns against mad cultists and Eldrazi monstrosities.

events.summary: Nights are lengthening faster than in any previous autumn.
events.quote: nights were lengthening faster than in any autumn past.

events.summary: Villagers consult a storybook for clues to saving the fading sun.
events.quote: The villagers pored through the old storybook, hoping that one of the tales within might hold some clue to saving the fading sun.

events.summary: Verna remarks on ominous ravens.
events.quote: One raven is a bad omen. Two are a curse.

events.summary: Sigarda and Sorin battle while Arlinn and Teferi recover the key from the Markov catacombs.
events.quote: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

events.summary: Uda relocates and takes up skaab sewing after werewolves destroy her shop.
events.quote: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

events.summary: Yzlkpk records a homunculus mimicking his movements.
events.quote: Day 77: The homunculus within the crystal continues to mimic my every movement.

events.summary: Skirsdag cultists transfer worship to a new demon after Griselbrand's defeat.
events.quote: Griselbrand's defeat did not mark the end of the Skirsdag cult.

events.summary: Kaya describes a covetous geist killing for spite.
events.quote: It has no need of wealth in the afterlife.

events.summary: Emili warns people not to investigate cellar groans.
events.quote: If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate.

events.summary: A cultist begs Ormendahl to release the strength within.
events.quote: Great Ormendahl, I kneel before you, a fragment of your will, a servant of your tyranny.

events.summary: Tovolar's howlpack grows bolder, smarter and stronger.
events.quote: Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

events.summary: Gisa taunts a hobbling zombie's opponent.
events.quote: I see someone tried to stop you, my pet. How delightful.

events.summary: Jadar raises a corpse from the river.
events.quote: Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?

events.summary: Ormendahl addresses Jerren as a faithful insect.
events.quote: Ah, Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect.

events.summary: Gisa boasts of her Morkrut Behemoth against her brother's creations.
events.quote: Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this.

events.summary: Olivia ambushes a ritualist and sends a wedding invitation.
events.quote: I'll send you an invitation to my wedding.

events.summary: Stromkirk members borrow from blood tithes with House Voldaren ascendant.
events.quote: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.

events.summary: The Voldaren demand blood offerings from villagers.
events.quote: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory.

events.summary: An executioner is found dead with ashen handprints after a killer's burning.
events.quote: The next day, the executioner was found with ashen handprints on his throat.

events.summary: Anje's agent threatens a victim with her message.
events.quote: Lady Anje sends her regards.

events.summary: Tovolar's howl is answered from inside the Harvesttide festival.
events.quote: When Tovolar's howl sounded from the woods, it was answered from the heart of the festival.

events.summary: Barnes describes Tovolar's cunning campaign of terror.
events.quote: This Tovolar is no brainless brute.

events.summary: Tovolar joins the fray and cathars fall.
events.quote: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

events.summary: Anje says vampires chase the joy of their first night's feast.
events.quote: We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast.

events.summary: Tovolar's howl compels Arlinn's own pack to betray her.
events.quote: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.

events.summary: An Ashmouth dragon is born and burns a province.
events.quote: A dragon is born. A province burns.

events.summary: Gatstaf is left unguarded and echoes with howls.
events.quote: With no guards to be seen, the cobbled streets of Gatstaf echoed with howls.

events.summary: Werewolf attacks revive brutal weapons unseen since the Travails.
events.quote: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

events.summary: Witch, werewolf and cathar defend the Sungold Lock against Tovolar's assault.
events.quote: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

events.summary: Dawnhart witches lash out at werewolf intruders after their ritual is disrupted.
events.quote: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.

events.summary: Halana comments that the Ulvenwald agrees a stone creature cannot fly.
events.quote: A creature of stone was never meant to fly. And I see the Ulvenwald agrees with me.

events.summary: Katilda says even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu.
events.quote: Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time.

events.summary: Paulin identifies a shadowbeast that is neither werewolf nor vampire.
events.quote: Werewolves leave tracks. Vampires leave wrung-out corpses. This is something else.

events.summary: Bruno dies after mistaking a werewolf for a wolf.
events.quote: Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo

events.summary: Dawnhart wardens say the day-night balance is shattered and the Moonsilver Key must be found.
events.quote: The balance of day and night is shattered. We must find the Moonsilver Key.

events.summary: Katilda states the angels have abandoned them but Ghrin-Danu has not.
events.quote: The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not.

events.summary: Odric declares that justice is not mercy.
events.quote: Do not confuse justice with mercy.

events.summary: The Moonsilver Key must be reunited with the Sungold Lock to restore the day-night balance.
events.quote: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.

events.summary: Captain Eberheart advises a single well-aimed shot at a charging werewolf.
events.quote: When a werewolf charges, you'll only have time for one shot.

events.summary: Katilda warns that the land is sending a warning across Stensia, Nephalia and Innistrad.
events.quote: The land is sending a warning.

events.summary: Ivold believes he sees geists at last.
events.quote: Ivold gasped in surprise.

events.summary: Ancient evils dwell in the burning Ashmouth chasm.
events.quote: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

relations.quote: One raven is a bad omen. Two are a curse.

relations.note: They battle while Arlinn and Teferi recover the key.
relations.quote: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.
Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

relations.note: His howl compels her pack to betray her.
relations.quote: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.
Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time.

relations.note: Ormendahl calls Jerren a faithful, useful insect.
relations.quote: Ah, Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect.

relations.note: The cult worships demons including Ormendahl.
relations.quote: Skirsdag cultists believe that the right poison "purifies" a tainted soul before it makes its way to Ormendahl.
